messages:
Morgan L: heads up — noticed a bump in onboarding rows with missing owner/email/plan fields, and the automation is sending them to the playbook dead-letter queue. seeing ~420 in the last 6h. @sanjay can you confirm it's the new ingest?
Sanjay K: yep saw the alert from the ETL job around 03:12 UTC, content schema changed for a partner feed. some fields are nested now so the mapper returns nulls.
Anya P: ouch. those deadletters block auto-assign playbooks, so customers stay in limbo. we should triage: 1) short-term backfill 2) stop routing to live workflows 3) long-term schema fix.
Riley Z: I can run a quick backfill for primary contact + owner from last known good snapshot if we can get the query.
Sanjay K: working on a diagnostic query, dropping here for Riley: ```sql
-- find rows with sparse contact metadata
select id, payload->>'partner_id' as partner, payload->'contacts' as contacts
from onboarding_events
where created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
and (payload->>'primary_email' is null or payload->>'owner' is null);
```
Riley Z: thanks. will run locally against staging and prepare a minimal backfill script to copy owner/email from contacts[0] when present.
cs-playbook-bot: deadletter queue size for playbook:onboard-assign exceeded threshold (420 events) :warning:
Morgan L: propose we add a temporary routing rule: if playbook:onboard-assign deadletter > 100 then route to queue 'cs-manual-review' to avoid blocking downstream automation. quick rollback if that causes noise.
Anya P: +1 do that. also add a metric-tag so we can track how many of those are partner-schema vs real missing data.
Sanjay K: I'll push a mapper patch to handle the nested contact shape; ETA 2 hrs. will also output a list of partner_ids impacted so we can notify partners if needed.
Riley Z: backfill script ran against staging, cleaned ~180 rows (contacts had email but owner missing). will schedule a small run in prod at 02:00 PT with @Anya signoff.
Morgan L: assign action items: @Sanjay patch mapper (+PR link when ready), @Riley backfill runbook + dry-run report, @Anya enable manual routing and monitor. can we do a 15m sync at 01:30 PT?
Anya P: yep 01:30 PT works. I'll create a short runbook entry in Confluence and add pre/post checks.
Sanjay K: PR opened: https://git.redwood/s/ingest/mapper/pulls/412 — includes safe parsing for contacts array and unit tests. will redeploy after review.
Riley Z: prod dry-run scheduled, will post result in this thread once complete.
Morgan L: thanks team. if we see any spikes after the mapper fix, we should consider a temporary partner-specific schema gate. :thumbsup:
